name: TfL Unified API (open data)
gives: line status, arrivals, road disruptions and other open transport data for London

why.quote: You are free to: Copy, publish, distribute and transmit the Information; Adapt the Information and Exploit the Information commercially and non-commercially
why.basis: TfL's Transport Data Service terms, read by Dinis Cruz in a browser (tfl.gov.uk answers agents with a bot check). Credits: 'Powered by TfL Open Data' and the Ordnance Survey and Geomni statements; at most 500 calls a minute per feed.

interface: REST JSON API; the portal asks for a registered account and an app_key (a free 500 requests data plan): that is a key from Dinis, not taken here.
notes: Gap: TfL's terms page refused our reader (403), so the attribution wording is not confirmed by us from TfL. The brief gives the attribution 'Powered by TfL Open Data'; to be checked against the terms by a person before use. Needs a free key from Dinis before any collection.
how: Not collected yet. Decision by Dinis, 18 Nov 2026 about 22:20 UTC (PrompTugal__News__Website board/guidance/2026-11-18-london.md): London is the first place beyond Portugal; each UK source goes on the register with its terms read first, then is collected to the pipeline standard.
